question: On 7 November 2022, Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended and offered prayers at celebrations of the _______ Prakash Parv of Shri Guru Nanak Dev Ji at New Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**553rd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **7th November 2022**, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the celebration of the **553rd Prakash Parv of Shri Guru Nanak Dev Ji** in **New Delhi.**
 
• This event marks the **birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji**, the founder of Sikhism.
 
• It is a significant occasion for Sikhs worldwide, **celebrated with prayers and festivities.**
 
• The Prime Minister was honoured with traditional Sikh gifts at the event - **a Shawl, Siropa** (a respectful term for a ceremonial robe of honour), **and a Sword.**
 
• The celebration reinforces India's commitment to upholding the teachings and values of Guru Nanak Dev Ji including **equality, fraternity, and service to others.**
